# pop execution

Inspect and recover exact transaction submissions

## pop execution status

Inspect the saved submission for an account

```text
pop execution status [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--address` | string | no | - | Account address; no signing key is needed |

## pop execution recover

Reconcile a saved submission with bounded read-only RPC; never resends

```text
pop execution recover [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--abandon` | boolean | no | `false` | Release only a provably pre-broadcast record; never an uncertain send |
| `--address` | string | no | - | Account address; no signing key is needed |
| `--candidate-tx` | string | no | - | Exact mined EOA candidate after the saved prefix window |
| `--max-blocks` | number | no | `16` | Prefix recovery window (1–64 blocks) |

_Global flags: --org, --chain, --rpc, --json, --address, --private-key, --dry-run, --yes, --verbose, --quiet, --preflight (see [index.md](index.md))_
